verdict.rationale: Salesforce documents an official MCP server, public APIs, lead management, built-in lead routing for owner assignment, and agents that qualify inbound leads, so the pieces of an agent-driven lead workflow exist. Nothing documents the end-to-end flow through the API or MCP server, and there is no evidence of company-data enrichment. Missing for 10: documented API/MCP lead creation, built-in firmographic company-data enrichment, evidence that owner assignment can be triggered via API/MCP, hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end agent flow.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent enrich a new lead end-to-end via the API or MCP server — creating the record, filling company data, and assigning an owner

citations.quote: official MCP server documented at https://github.com/salesforcecli/mcp
